details: Private originals include configurations, sampling seeds, grants/ledgers/markers, raw archives, local H4 inputs and execution records. Absolute paths and original per-file fingerprints remain in a separate local custody audit. Public SOURCE/result/audit references are in the catalogue. No private bytes or seed-recovery information are reproduced.
public_verifiability_limit: Public receipts and fixed result tables can be checked; original private runtime/seed/control/raw material is not made independently reconstructible by this catalogue.
